# Wikimedia
> The Wikimedia movement is a global community of people, projects, and activities working together to create and share knowledge freely.

Wikimedia.org is the central portal for the Wikimedia movement, linking to its major knowledge projects, governance resources, technical infrastructure, community spaces, and the Wikimedia Foundation.

## Movement Overview
- [Wikimedia Homepage](https://www.wikimedia.org/): Central portal to Wikimedia projects, movement information, and access to major community resources.
- [Our Projects](https://www.wikimedia.org/our-projects/): Overview of Wikimedia’s major free knowledge projects and their purposes.
- [Movement Affiliates](https://www.wikimedia.org/movement/affiliates/): Directory of Wikimedia chapters, thematic organizations, and user groups worldwide.
- [Movement Charter](https://www.wikimedia.org/movement/charter/): Information and resources related to the Wikimedia Movement Charter process.
- [Wikimedia Foundation](https://wikimediafoundation.org/): Official site of the Wikimedia Foundation, including organizational and strategic information.

## Wikimedia Projects
- [Wikipedia](https://www.wikipedia.org/): Free encyclopedia written collaboratively by volunteers in many languages.
- [Wiktionary](https://www.wiktionary.org/): Multilingual dictionary and lexical resource created by contributors.
- [Wikibooks](https://www.wikibooks.org/): Collection of free textbooks, manuals, and instructional materials.
- [Wikiquote](https://www.wikiquote.org/): Repository of sourced quotations organized by topic and person.
- [Wikisource](https://www.wikisource.org/): Free library of source texts and public domain works.
- [Wikiversity](https://www.wikiversity.org/): Learning resources, educational activities, and collaborative study materials.
- [Wikivoyage](https://www.wikivoyage.org/): Free travel guide with destination and itinerary information.
- [Wikinews](https://www.wikinews.org/): Collaborative news reporting and original journalism project.

## Media and Structured Knowledge Projects
- [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/): Repository of freely licensed images, audio, video, and other media.
- [Wikidata](https://www.wikidata.org/): Structured open knowledge base supporting Wikimedia projects and external reuse.
- [Wikispecies](https://species.wikimedia.org/): Open species directory covering taxonomy and biological classification.
- [MediaWiki](https://www.mediawiki.org/): Open-source wiki software platform that powers Wikimedia sites.
- [Meta-Wiki](https://meta.wikimedia.org/): Coordination wiki for cross-project discussion, policy, and movement planning.

## Community and Governance
- [Meta-Wiki Community Portal](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Community_portal): Central coordination space for cross-project community discussions and initiatives.
- [Wikimedia Movement](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_movement): Overview of the Wikimedia movement’s structure, participants, and activities.
- [Wikimedia Foundation Governance Wiki](https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Home): Governance policies, board materials, and foundation governance documentation.
- [Universal Code of Conduct](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Universal_Code_of_Conduct): Movement-wide behavioral standards for Wikimedia contributors and spaces.
- [Movement Strategy](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Strategy/Wikimedia_movement/2018-20): Strategic recommendations and process documentation for Wikimedia’s future direction.
- [Wikimedia Affiliates Portal](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_movement_affiliates): Information about recognized Wikimedia affiliates and organizational models.

## Technical Documentation
- [MediaWiki Documentation](https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Documentation): Main entry point for MediaWiki software documentation and developer resources.
- [Manual:Contents](https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Manual:Contents): Comprehensive manual for installing, configuring, and administering MediaWiki.
- [API:Main page](https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/API:Main_page): Documentation for the MediaWiki Action API and related interfaces.
- [Extension Manual](https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Manual:Extensions): Guide to discovering, installing, and developing MediaWiki extensions.
- [Help:Contents](https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Help:Contents): User-facing help for editing, formatting, and working with wiki pages.
- [Developer Hub](https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Developer_hub): Starting point for MediaWiki development, architecture, and contribution workflows.

## APIs and Data Access
- [MediaWiki Action API](https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/API:Main_page): Reference and guides for querying and editing Wikimedia wikis programmatically.
- [REST API](https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/API:REST_API): Documentation for MediaWiki REST endpoints and modern API usage.
- [Wikidata Query Service](https://query.wikidata.org/): SPARQL endpoint for querying Wikidata’s structured knowledge graph.
- [Wikidata API](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Wikidata:Data_access): Overview of APIs, dumps, and tools for accessing Wikidata content.
- [Enterprise APIs and Data Feeds](https://enterprise.wikimedia.com/): Commercial-grade Wikimedia APIs and data services for large-scale reuse.
- [Database Downloads](https://dumps.wikimedia.org/): Public data dumps for Wikimedia projects and related datasets.

## Developer Infrastructure
- [Wikitech](https://wikitech.wikimedia.org/): Technical wiki for Wikimedia infrastructure, operations, and platform engineering.
- [Developer Portal](https://developer.wikimedia.org/): Entry point for Wikimedia technical communities, tools, and contribution resources.
- [Phabricator](https://phabricator.wikimedia.org/): Issue tracking and project management platform for Wikimedia technical work.
- [Gerrit Code Review](https://gerrit.wikimedia.org/): Code review system for Wikimedia software repositories and patches.
- [Toolforge](https://toolforge.org/): Hosting platform for community-built tools and bots serving Wikimedia projects.
- [Cloud Services Portal](https://wikitech.wikimedia.org/wiki/Portal:Cloud_VPS): Documentation for Wikimedia Cloud VPS and related developer services.

## Research, Data, and Analytics
- [Wikimedia Research](https://research.wikimedia.org/): Research portal covering studies, publications, datasets, and collaboration opportunities.
- [Analytics](https://wikitech.wikimedia.org/wiki/Analytics): Documentation for Wikimedia analytics systems, data pipelines, and metrics infrastructure.
- [Data Services](https://wikitech.wikimedia.org/wiki/Data_Services): Overview of shared data platforms and services used across Wikimedia.
- [Event Platform](https://wikitech.wikimedia.org/wiki/Event_Platform): Documentation for Wikimedia’s event collection and processing infrastructure.
- [AQS Documentation](https://doc.wikimedia.org/generated-data-platform/aqs/analytics-api/): Reference for Wikimedia analytics query service APIs and endpoints.

## Foundation and Legal
- [Wikimedia Foundation](https://wikimediafoundation.org/): Organizational information, programs, leadership, and strategic priorities of the foundation.
- [Terms of Use](https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:Terms_of_Use): Terms governing use of Wikimedia websites and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:Privacy_policy): Policy describing collection, use, and protection of user information.
- [Legal Policies](https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:Policy_portal): Central portal for Wikimedia Foundation policies and legal documents.
- [Transparency Reports](https://wikimediafoundation.org/about/transparency/): Reports on legal requests, transparency practices, and accountability measures.
- [Annual Reports](https://wikimediafoundation.org/about/annualreport/): Yearly reports summarizing Wikimedia Foundation impact, finances, and activities.

## News and Communications
- [Diff](https://diff.wikimedia.org/): Wikimedia movement blog featuring stories, announcements, and community perspectives.
- [Wikimedia Foundation News](https://wikimediafoundation.org/news/): Official foundation news, press releases, and announcements.
- [Wikimedia Blog Category on Diff](https://diff.wikimedia.org/category/wikimedia-foundation/): Posts focused on Wikimedia Foundation initiatives and updates.
- [Tech News](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Tech/News): Regular updates about software changes affecting Wikimedia contributors and admins.
- [Press Room](https://wikimediafoundation.org/about/press/): Media resources, press contacts, and official statements from the foundation.
